criteria.criterion: A test loads the repository's real athena.toml (with its [parallel] section) through Config and passes; a config without [parallel] parses and yields max_concurrency 1; a config with an unknown top-level section is rejected. Run `cargo test`.
criteria.evidence: config.rs adds three tests. the_real_athena_toml_parses_with_its_parallel_section checks that REPO_CONFIG contains [parallel], parses it, and gets max_concurrency 1. a_config_without_parallel_runs_one_item_at_a_time strips the section and gets 1, and an empty [parallel] also gives 1. max_concurrency_must_lie_between_one_and_the_ceiling accepts 4, refuses 0 and 5, and refuses an unknown key. The existing unknown_keys_are_rejected test still rejects a [surprise] section. All 15 config tests passed, and the full `cargo test` passed.

criteria.criterion: A drain test with bound 1 shows items run strictly in the existing order, and all existing drain tests pass unchanged. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria.evidence: with_a_bound_of_one_items_run_one_after_another_in_plan_order checks the exact log start/end/land/rate for a, b and c, in order. It also checks that the unchanged `drain::drain` entry point produces the identical log. The diff to tests/drain.rs is one hunk appended at the end of the file, so no existing test was changed. All 65 drain tests passed.

criteria.criterion: A drain test with bound 2 and two independent items in one group has both in flight at once (barrier; fails if serial), and an item depending on another starts only after it finishes. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli`.
criteria.evidence: In with_a_bound_of_two_independent_items_are_in_flight_together_and_a_dependent_waits, items a and b each wait until in_flight >= 2 before setting `met`. A serial loop times out after 3s with met false, and the test asserts met. It also asserts that end a and land a come before start c, where c depends on a. A control run with bound 1 asserts that met stays false. The test passed.

criteria.criterion: Tests show one item's failure or refusal does not stop its siblings, the worker bound is never exceeded, and Stop starts no further item. Run `cargo test`.
criteria.evidence: The following tests passed. one_items_failure_or_refusal_does_not_stop_its_siblings: a is rejected twice and d is refused by the plan, yet siblings b and c still land, and the stop reason is RepeatedFailure for a. the_worker_bound_is_never_exceeded: with 6 items and bound 2, most_in_flight is exactly 2. workers_together_never_spend_past_the_budget_or_the_job_limit: the shared budget and job limit both hold. a_stop_asked_for_starts_no_further_item: with 2 workers, c and d never start, and a and b finish and land.

criteria.criterion: Ordering and retry rules are unchanged; `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo fmt --check` all pass.
criteria.evidence: All three commands passed. I read the code: `work()` keeps the ATTEMPTS and retry logic, and with bound <= 1 `drain_parallel` calls the same run_serially that `drain` uses. The plan order comes from Plan::order as before. All existing drain tests pass unchanged.

criteria.criterion: athena.toml gains [parallel] only together with its schema field in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs in the same change; the field, default (1) and ceiling are documented where defined, and the athena.toml change is named and justified in the final report.
criteria.evidence: The same diff adds the [parallel] section to athena.toml and `Config::parallel` to config.rs. Doc comments there cover the field, the default of 1 (default_max_concurrency) and the ceiling (MAX_CONCURRENCY_CEILING = 4, refused rather than clamped by validate), and athena.toml has its own comment. The CHANGELOG entry says 'Governance path changed: `athena.toml`' and gives the justification. The final report itself is outside this snapshot, so this rests on the CHANGELOG and docs.

criteria.criterion: Drain and Report docs no longer say the loop runs one job at a time; docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and CHANGELOG.md state what this slice built and what remains (multi-job `athena go`, --pr phase).
criteria.evidence: I updated docs in five places: the drain.rs module doc, the Report::plan_groups doc, the main.rs drain help, README, and roles-and-ladder.md. Each now describes `max_concurrency`, and 'one job at a time' remains only to describe the default of 1. Searching for 'one job at a time' finds it elsewhere only in a historical decisions.md entry and an older CHANGELOG entry. parallel-jobs.md section 0 and the CHANGELOG list what was built and what remains: multi-job `athena go`, the `--pr` phase, submit-time refusal, and cross-wave groups.

findings.summary: Five changed files are not on the expected deliverables list: README.md, crates/athena-core/src/admission.rs, crates/athena-core/src/gh.rs, crates/athena-core/src/jev.rs and docs/design/roles-and-ladder.md.
findings.evidence: Each change has a reason. gh.rs and jev.rs add `Send + Sync` to two traits, which sharing state across threads requires. The jev.rs test transport moves from RefCell to Mutex for the same reason. The admission.rs test used `[parallel]` as a made-up unknown section and would break now that the section is real, so it was renamed to `[fanout]`. The README and roles-and-ladder.md edits remove 'one job at a time' wording, which criterion 7 needs. The CHANGELOG discloses the Send+Sync change.

findings.summary: A panic in a worker thread ends the whole drain; it is not isolated per item.
findings.evidence: std::thread::scope re-raises a panic from any spawned thread when the scope ends. parallel-jobs.md section 0 says this openly ('panics in a worker are not isolated'). With the default of 1 nothing changes.

findings.summary: With bound > 1, the plan-groups output still labels groups '(could run in parallel)'.
findings.evidence: The label is still accurate under the default of 1, and an existing test asserts the text. It could be reworded later.

summary: This change does what the retry asked for, and I recommend accepting it. `athena drain` now runs the items of one plan group at the same time, up to `[parallel] max_concurrency`. The default is 1 and the most allowed is 4; a value outside 1 to 4 is refused when the configuration is read. The setting's field in config.rs and the athena.toml section arrive in the same change, and a test parses the real athena.toml, so the file parses at every commit. With the default of 1, a test shows the run log is identical to the existing `drain`. With a bound of 2, a test requires two items to be running at once and fails if they run one after another. It also checks that an item depending on another starts only after that one has finished. Further tests cover these cases: one item's failure or refusal does not stop the others; never more than the set number run at once; running jobs together stay within the budget and the job limit; and a stop request starts no further item. I ran the new tests, `cargo test -p athena-cli`, the full `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings` and `cargo fmt --check`, and all passed. The docs and CHANGELOG say what was built and what remains. Five changed files are outside the expected list (README, roles-and-ladder.md, and admission/gh/jev.rs), but each change is needed and explained, so I rated it minor. A crash in one worker thread ends the whole drain; the design doc says so.
